title: Heidi and Otto — Breakfast proof
productionNotes: Exactly TWO actual long-haired tricolor Bernese Mountain DOGS in the supplied first frame. HEIDI: elderly dog, silver muzzle, burgundy collar, screen LEFT on cushion. OTTO: stocky dog, ochre collar, screen RIGHT on floor. Preserve this exact populated composition. No humans, extra animals, reflected figures, tools or moving furniture. Static dog-eye-level camera, closed snowy window. Minimal ordinary canine head/eye movements only; paws stay grounded. Heidi alone has a low, measured older female voice. Otto is SILENT with mouth closed. Names inside dialogue are addresses, not speaker changes. Only quoted dialogue is spoken. No music, narrator or added lines; quiet steady room ambience. No cuts, fades or dissolves.

script.title: Heidi and Otto — 12 seconds
script.sourceTranscript:
HEIDI: Otto. You were meant to clear the path.
HEIDI: Not bring it in. Breakfast is waiting.
script.sourceDescription: A simple two-dog exposition exchange establishing Heidi’s authority and Otto’s groundskeeping work, ending with an invitation to breakfast.

shots.title: The reprimand
shots.dialogue: HEIDI: Otto. You were meant to clear the path.
shots.visual: 0–0.7s: Heidi looks from Otto’s muddy paws to his face. 0.7–4.2s: Heidi alone speaks the quoted line, naturally and dryly. Otto remains silent and does not mouth any words. 4.2–7s: Otto looks down at his muddy paws, then sheepishly back at Heidi. Heidi waits. No dog changes position; end on the shared look.
shots.audio: Only Heidi speaks. No other voice; steady quiet room tone.

shots.title: The welcome
shots.dialogue: HEIDI: Not bring it in. Breakfast is waiting.
shots.visual: Continue exact previous composition and motion without replay. Local 0–0.4s: Heidi softens slightly. 0.4–3.8s: Heidi alone speaks the new line, same low older female voice. Otto listens with mouth closed. 3.8–5s: Otto lifts gaze reassured; brief shared look. Neither dog stands or moves location. End before any new action.
shots.audio: Only Heidi speaks; no repeat of the previous line. Same quiet room tone.
